about: The visibility rule of docs/panel-layout.md "Visibility", one vector for every language (#76): a declared rule (`values` or `atLeast`) is the hex `mask` (bit v set: shown at value v), and a control it governs is shown at governing `value` exactly when `value` is an integer 0..63 whose bit is set. test/visible-when-vector.test.mjs reads it through visibilityMask and isVisible (tools/panel-description.mjs), renderer/test/visible-when-vector.test.mjs through the C renderer (a control whose visibleWhen default is `value`, drawn or not by --rects): both must give `shown`.

vectors.name: atLeast 2 (a count: band 2 shows while the count is 2 or more)
